correctness.rationale: For a connected star with integer degrees 1<=b1<...<bk, the exact parent-shift block matrix isolates k homogeneous co-shifts Bj. Each BjBj*=bjI yields a right inverse for |lambda|<sqrt(bj), a Neumann inverse outside, and radial-shift non-surjectivity on the boundary. The adjoint has no eigenvalues by induction on depth. Explicit antichain difference-wavelets form an invariant reducing infinite-multiplicity co-shift at degree bk, giving Rota universality inside the outer disk. Outside the outer disk injectivity rules out universality. Descendant counts yield power norms and growth radii. The standalone checker passed 532 finite checks, which are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete natural connected-tree classification solves the motivating spectral-annulus questions for all finite sets of distinct integer branch degrees, separates surjectivity from Rota universality on arbitrarily many concentric circles, and gives exact point spectrum, power norm and radius information. It is not a single numerical example; it exhibits the different mechanisms governing universal invariant restrictions and global solvability.
